title: Message from the MICRO 2024 Program Chairs
problem: Not applicable. This is an editorial message from program chairs, not a technical research paper addressing a specific problem.
motivation: To present and contextualize the 57th MICRO conference's technical program and record-breaking statistics.
method: This editorial message reports on the MICRO 2024 conference's scope: it received 497 paper submissions, representing a 15% increase from prior years, and 113 papers were selected for publication. The evaluation involved 152 program committee members (senior researchers who coordinate the review) and 176 external reviewers (independent experts who assess submissions).
key_novelty: This is a conference announcement of participation statistics and scale, not a research paper with technical findings.
limitations: Not a technical paper; no research limitations to discuss.
